text:
Maya: Quick RFC follow-up — we need to finalize a matrix-wise casting surface for FP8/INT8/4-bit support. Goal: allow mixed-precision within a single layer when safe, but keep a simple runtime contract.

Aj: +1. Question: per-matmul or per-weight-matrix? per-matmul feels more flexible for attn vs mlp.

Sandeep: per-matmul is ideal for quality, but adds branching at runtime. Perf hit might be small if we batch decisions. main concern: how we express compatibility in the model artifact.

Olivia: Proposal: embed a tiny metadata blob per matrix: {cast_hint, tolerance_tag, preferred_order}. Runtime uses that to pick kernels. Fallback levels: strict -> fail, best_effort -> quantize with calibrations, degrade -> use higher-precision fallback.

Leo: We also need an ops-level API so graph transforms can rewrite groups of matmuls into a single kernel when all members share the same cast policy. Otherwise we'll lose fusion.

Maya: Exactly. Two interface boundaries: 1) model artifact metadata (static) 2) per-request runtime overrides (dynamic) for canaries.

Aj: Can we show a minimal config snippet?

Olivia: Sure, sketch below:
```json
{
  "matrices": {
    "attn_qk": { "cast_hint": "fp8", "tolerance_tag": "strict" },
    "mlp_fc1": { "cast_hint": "int8", "tolerance_tag": "best_effort" }
  },
  "runtime_policy": "best_effort",
  "fallback_order": ["fp8","int8","fp16"]
}
```

Sandeep: Nice. A few tradeoffs to call out:
- FP8 often yields 1.5-2x perf vs fp16 on some kernels, but calibration variance is higher on emergent tasks.
- INT8 stable for conv-like dense matmuls, but attention key-query pairs can break if distribution shifts.
- 4-bit (GPTQ-style) is great for cost but brittle for long-context tasks.

Leo: For rollout: start with non-critical endpoints, collect per-matrix quality regressions, evaluate at prompt-set granularity, and add canary heuristics to bump precision if degscore exceeds threshold.

Maya: Telemetry surface we need: per-matrix degscore, fallback rate, latency delta, kernel choice histogram. Add tags for prompt cohort and model version.

runtime-bot: New metric group created: quant.matrix_degscore, quant.fallback_rate, quant.kernel_choice (auto-created by infra).

Olivia: Ops API idea: POST /v1/models/:id/precision-override {"matrix": "mlp_fc1","policy":"fp16"} for live canaries. Keep it limited to admins or canary tokens.

Aj: How do we express composability for graph-level fusion? Maybe a small IR annotation: "fusion_key" that forces matrices to be considered as a unit.

Sandeep: Good call. IR sketch: annotate nodes with "fusion_key":"group42". Graph rewriter can check "all-members-cast-compatible(group42)" before producing a fused kernel.

Maya: Action items:
- Olivia: author artifact metadata spec + examples (this week)
- Leo: perf microbench harness for per-matmul decision overhead (2w)
- Sandeep: design metrics degscore algorithm + alert thresholds (1w)
- Aj: draft ops API + auth model (1w)

Olivia: I'll start the spec in the repo.

Aj: I'll draft the API in PR stage.

Leo: Will coordinate benchmarks.

Sandeep: Will prototype degscore and share sample curves.

Maya: Cool. We'll reconvene after the initial PRs. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
